block_reason: Post-freeze formal-launch orchestration defect: the frozen infrastructure workflow persisted the immutable authorization lock using the GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN. GitHub suppresses recursive workflow triggering from such token-authenticated pushes, so the path-filtered Formal Sequence push workflow did not start. The freeze commit produced zero Actions runs, the formal ledger remained 0/0/0, and Candidate-v13 was never formally invoked. Under the preregistered post-freeze bug rule, v3 cannot patch the frozen workflow or authorization mechanism and rerun; a fresh v4 infrastructure lineage is required for any repair.
